body: Please is week landlord ko signed lease copy bhej do.
Ho jayega — kal bhej dunga; 9 baje ka reminder chahiye.
Confirm hai — tuition trial appointment 23 September Wednesday ko hai.
Maine tuition appointment cancel nahi kiya — booked hai.
Main Monday se school pickup rota handle kar sakta hun.

Badhiya — reimbursement form done mark karo.
Ruko — form abhi done nahi hai, approval pending hai.
Main January me half marathon daudna chahta hun.
Training next week se shuru hogi.
Mere cousin ka October marathon plan yahan share hua hai.
Next Saturday parents ki anniversary dinner plan hai — koi caterer idea?
Aur jab bhi convenient ho tuition invoice copy bhej dena.
Please Thursday 24 September ke liye dentist appointment book karo.
Dentist appointment book ho gaya — Thursday 4 baje.
